note: Invented daily figures through 21 Oct 2026 so the executive pages and charts can be reviewed. Not live Think4Ever data.

metrics.name: Ad spend
metrics.definition: Sum of Meta, LinkedIn, and Google Ads spend in the month. Close to 100% of the monthly budget is the goal.

metrics.name: Impressions
metrics.definition: Paid impressions across Meta, LinkedIn, and Google Ads. The dashboard breaks this out by platform.

metrics.name: Clicks
metrics.definition: Paid clicks across Meta, LinkedIn, and Google Ads.

metrics.name: Click-through rate
metrics.definition: Paid clicks divided by paid impressions.

metrics.name: Cost per click
metrics.definition: Ad spend divided by paid clicks. Lower is better. A shorter range keeps this cost. It does not scale it.

metrics.name: Paid landing sessions
metrics.definition: Landing sessions whose UTM medium is paid (cpc or paid social).

metrics.name: Paid sign-ups
metrics.definition: External platform sign-ups attributed to a paid campaign. Internal accounts are excluded.

metrics.name: Cost per sign-up
metrics.definition: Ad spend divided by paid sign-ups. Lower is better. A shorter range keeps this cost. It does not scale it.

metrics.name: LinkedIn post impressions
metrics.definition: Organic impressions on the Think4Ever Global page. This stays app-wide when a country is selected.

metrics.name: LinkedIn engagement rate
metrics.definition: Organic engagements divided by organic impressions on the Think4Ever Global page. Stays app-wide when a country is selected.

metrics.name: New LinkedIn followers
metrics.definition: Net new followers of the Think4Ever Global page in the month. Stays app-wide when a country is selected.

metrics.name: Campaigns with spend
metrics.definition: Count of campaigns that spent money in the month.

metrics.name: Landing sessions
metrics.definition: Visits to the HubSpot-tracked landing pages.

metrics.name: Visitors
metrics.definition: Users on the landing in Google Analytics.

metrics.name: Engaged sessions
metrics.definition: Sessions that lasted more than 10 seconds, viewed 2 or more pages, or fired a key event.

metrics.name: Engagement rate
metrics.definition: Engaged sessions divided by sessions.

metrics.name: Sign-up form starts
metrics.definition: People who started the landing sign-up form.

metrics.name: Form completed
metrics.definition: People who completed the landing sign-up form (the sign_up event).

metrics.name: Form completion
metrics.definition: Form completed divided by form started. The share of people who finish the sign-up form.

metrics.name: External form sign-ups
metrics.definition: HubSpot contacts from the landing form. think4ever.com addresses are removed.

metrics.name: New accounts
metrics.definition: New external accounts created in the product. Internal accounts are removed. The Growth page compares this count with the previous month.

metrics.name: Visit-to-sign-up rate
metrics.definition: External platform sign-ups divided by landing sessions.

metrics.name: Customers
metrics.definition: External accounts that are still open at the end of the period. Canceled and deleted accounts are not included.

metrics.name: Active customers
metrics.definition: Open accounts that used the app in the 7 days ending on the last day of the period.

metrics.name: Activity
metrics.definition: Active customers divided by open accounts. Active means they used the app in the last 7 days.

metrics.name: Accounts with a project
metrics.definition: Open accounts that have at least one project.

metrics.name: Share with a project
metrics.definition: Accounts with at least one project divided by open accounts.

metrics.name: Avg projects per account
metrics.definition: Projects divided by open accounts, at the end of the period. Accounts with no project pull this average down.

metrics.name: Avg credits per active customer
metrics.definition: Credits spent in the last 7 days divided by customers who used the app in those 7 days.

metrics.name: Cancellation rate
metrics.definition: Accounts canceled or deleted in the period divided by open accounts at the start of the period. Lower is better.

metrics.name: Churn rate
metrics.definition: Customers who paid last month and are no longer paying, divided by everyone who was paying at the end of last month. Lower is better.

metrics.name: New external accounts
metrics.definition: Same count as new accounts on Growth, repeated so the product section stands alone.

metrics.name: Activated accounts
metrics.definition: New external accounts that created a first project in the month.

metrics.name: Activation rate
metrics.definition: Activated accounts divided by new external accounts.

metrics.name: First builds
metrics.definition: Activated accounts that completed a first build in the month.

metrics.name: Build rate
metrics.definition: First builds divided by activated accounts.

metrics.name: Monthly active users
metrics.definition: Distinct external people active in the product during the month.

metrics.name: New-account retention
metrics.definition: Share of last month’s new external accounts who were active this month. October is blank because this window has no prior month.

metrics.name: New paid subscriptions
metrics.definition: External accounts that start a paid subscription. Internal accounts are excluded.

metrics.name: Sign-up to paid conversion
metrics.definition: Of the external platform sign-ups in the month, how many start a paid subscription. The number is paid accounts of that month’s sign-ups. A person counts in the month they signed up, including if they pay later.

metrics.name: Total acquisition spend
metrics.definition: Same dollars as ad spend, so this section can be read on its own. Close to 100% of the monthly budget is the goal.

metrics.name: CAC
metrics.definition: Ad spend divided by new sign-ups. For one day it is that day’s spend divided by that day’s new sign-ups. For a month it is the month’s spend divided by the month’s new sign-ups. Lower is better. Spend uses the campaign’s target country. Sign-ups use the account country.

metrics.name: Cost per paying customer
metrics.source: Meta, LinkedIn, Google Ads, platform billing (to confirm)
metrics.definition: Ad spend divided by new paid subscriptions. This is what it costs to get one customer who starts paying. Lower is better.

metrics.name: Cost per activated account
metrics.definition: Ad spend divided by activated accounts. Lower is better. Spend uses the campaign’s target country. Activated accounts use the account country.
